label: Classroom 019, DTU Elektro (building 352)
note: furnished classroom (tables, chairs, blackboards) with absorbers on the ceiling and on two walls, not quite a shoebox (a shelf under the windows covers the radiators); Readme.html gives octave T30 of 0.40-0.56 s (spk1) and 0.47-0.60 s (spk2) in the upper bands and 1.36 s and 0.89 s in the lowest; two loudspeaker positions spk1 (3.08, 4.07, 1.36 m) and spk2 (1.67, 8.04, 1.43 m) (Dynaudio BM6); per loudspeaker 3 robot positions, each with 310 points on and inside two spheres (radius 0.45 and 0.25 m, sph1-3) and 152 on a line (lin1-3); positions in metres from the south-east-bottom corner, no position repeated within 1 mm; files dated 24 May 2021; volume 174.5 m3 from the Readme dimensions (the room is not quite a shoebox); dtu_frequency_responses (classroom) is the same room, measured in 2019. Readme.html's T30 table has seven values under six band labels; the first is 63 Hz (1.36 s spk1, 0.89 s spk2). 50 Hz mains hum is in the tails at all positions; the 216 IRs graded C for tonal interference (mostly spk1 robot position 1, lin1 and sph1) measure the same decay times as the rest.
